note: MaToRiuKo's battle backgrounds for the current game version (SourceFiles, 18 Nov 2026). They replace the older scenes, which were offset. 'keep' = older scenes that stay.

desc.en: From Pokémon X/Y's Radiant Chamber.
desc.zh: 来自《宝可梦 X/Y》的光辉密室。

desc.en: Made from the battle-background template with a floor.
